what: NRCS SSURGO map-unit polygons round MDRS and the URC route area: the soil map urc.landscape.Soils paints (design spec 5.3). A copy of sim/data/research/ssurgo_polys.geojson.
source: USDA NRCS SSURGO, survey area UT631 'Henry Mountains Area, Utah, Parts of Garfield, Kane, and Wayne Counties', via Soil Data Access (https://sdmdataaccess.sc.egov.usda.gov/Tabular/post.rest)
extent: 10 map-unit polygons clipped to lon -110.810..-110.764, lat 38.390..38.432 (WGS84); a 1:24,000 survey, so the boundaries are coarse
properties: mukey, musym, muname; components, horizons and area fractions are in sim/data/research/ssurgo_soils.json
